gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Calendar configured to end on the Sunday nearest to the end of August, divided into 13 even months of 4 weeks, with the leap week in month 13.
ADDED i2: An accounting leap year has 53 weeks (371 days) instead of the standard 52 weeks (364 days).
ADDED i3: The year ends on the nearest Sunday to August 31. That Sunday can fall as late as September 3rd (3 days after August 31), so September 3 is used as the anchor.
ADDED i4: Returns the accounting year-end date for the given ISO year: the Sunday on or before September 3rd, which is the nearest Sunday to the end of August.
ADDED i5: Returns whether the given accounting year is a leap year, by checking whether it spans 371 days (the gap between two consecutive year-end Sundays).
